title: Paneer Tikka

ingredients.title: For the Marinade
items: Paneer (cottage cheese) – 250 g, cut into 1½-inch cubes
Thick yogurt or hung curd – ½ cup
Mustard oil or vegetable oil – 2 tbsp

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: Onion – 1 small, cut into square chunks
Capsicum (bell pepper) – 1 small, cut into square chunks

instruction.title: Prepare the Marinade
steps: Add thick yogurt or hung curd to a large mixing bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, chaat masala, lemon juice, salt, and oil.
Mix thoroughly until the spices are evenly combined.
Add gram flour and stir until a smooth, thick marinade forms.

instruction.title: Marinate the Paneer & Vegetables
steps: Gently add the paneer cubes to the marinade and coat each piece evenly.
If using vegetables, add the onion, capsicum, and cherry tomatoes and coat them with the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
For deeper flavor, marinate overnight in the refrigerator.

instruction.title: Prepare the Skewers
steps: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Thread paneer and vegetables alternately onto the skewers.
Leave a little space between pieces so they cook and char evenly.

instruction.title: Cook – Oven Method
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F.
Place the skewers on a greased baking tray or grill rack.
Bake for 15–20 minutes, turning halfway through cooking.
Cook until the paneer is heated through and the edges are lightly charred.
For extra smoky char, broil for 2–3 minutes at the end.

instruction.title: Cook – Grill or BBQ Method
steps: Preheat the grill or BBQ to medium-high heat.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10–12 minutes.
Turn the skewers occasionally so the paneer and vegetables cook evenly.
Brush lightly with butter or oil during grilling to keep the paneer juicy.

instruction.title: Cook – Stovetop Method
steps: Heat a heavy skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat and lightly brush with oil.
Place the marinated paneer and vegetables in the pan without overcrowding.
Cook while turning occasionally until golden and lightly charred on all sides.
Remove from heat once the edges develop a tandoori-style char.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Transfer the hot paneer tikka to a serving plate.
Sprinkle with chaat masala and garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve immediately with green chutney and lemon wedges.

chefTips: Yogurt: Use hung curd to remove excess water and create a thick marinade that sticks well to the paneer.
Flavor: Mustard oil or ghee adds a more authentic smoky, tandoori-style flavor.
Heat: High cooking heat helps develop the signature golden and lightly charred edges.
Spacing: Do not overcrowd the skewers or pan; leave space between pieces for even cooking.
Paneer texture: Avoid overcooking, as paneer can become firm and chewy.

Smoky effect: For an optional dhungar effect, place a small piece of hot charcoal in a heatproof bowl with the marinated paneer, drizzle a little ghee over the charcoal, and cover briefly to infuse a smoky aroma.
